additional_info.subject: RE: ID0434986-DC/Si-D/IL - [MP / ND 170000126] Charging station not available-170000126 CRM:02919000086
additional_info.body:
Dear Gary,
Hope you’re doing well!
We have been unable to remotely update the charging station for a long time. It seems that the file is not downloading properly when attempting to update remotely.
Can you check what the reason is?
For the fault with this charging station, it seems that the fault is recurring. I am afraid that there is a problem with the KF13. Last week, the station was available for segments most of the time. It was unavailable and only after restarting the station would work for a short period of time for about 10 minutes and then return to alert about a fault with the KF13. I would appreciate your diagnosis. Is there any problem with one of the components and what the problem was? I consulted with Francisco in private and he told me that he is afraid that the KF13 is probably defective.
I would appreciate a comprehensive diagnosis from you.
Thank you in advance
,
Orel
